name.zh: Aster：ApolloX 网页和 API 下线
name.en: Aster: ApolloX website and API going offline

summary.zh: Aster 的旧品牌 ApolloX 网页和 API 下线,11 月 5 日前后收尾完成;还有余额、仓位的要尽快平仓提走。
summary.en: Aster is shutting down the old ApolloX website and API, finishing around Nov 5. If you still have a balance or positions there, close them and withdraw now.

deadlineNote.zh: 11 月 3 日 10:00(UTC)起开始收尾旧的 APX 合约,官方说约 48 小时完成,也就是约 11 月 5 日 10:00(UTC)。apollox.finance 网页和 API 随之下线。
deadlineNote.en: From Nov 3, 10:00 UTC, Aster began winding down the old APX contracts and said this would take about 48 hours, so it ends around Nov 5, 10:00 UTC. The apollox.finance website and API go offline with it.

who.zh: 在 ApolloX(`apollox.finance`)上还有余额或仓位的人。
who.en: Anyone who still has a balance or open positions on ApolloX (`apollox.finance`).

todo.zh: 平掉仓位,把钱提回自己的钱包。遇到问题,官方让找它 Discord 上的客服。
todo.en: Close your positions and withdraw to your own wallet. If something goes wrong, Aster says to contact its support on Discord.

caution.zh: 收尾完成以后还能不能直接调合约取,官方没有说。
caution.en: Aster hasn't said whether the contracts can still be used directly once the wind-down is finished.

label.en: Aster on X: Nov 3 wind-down post

name.zh: mETH Protocol：cmETH 往期活动奖励入口下线
name.en: mETH Protocol: page for past cmETH campaign rewards closing

summary.zh: mETH Protocol 往期 cmETH 活动的奖励入口 11 月 7 日下线,没领的奖励要在这之前领完。
summary.en: The page for rewards from past cmETH campaigns closes on Nov 7. Collect any rewards you haven't taken before then.

deadlineNote.zh: 11 月 7 日往期 cmETH 活动的奖励入口下线。cmETH 本身随时可以解押成 mETH 或跨链,不设截止。
deadlineNote.en: On Nov 7 the page for rewards from past cmETH campaigns closes. cmETH itself can still be unstaked to mETH or bridged at any time; there's no deadline for that.

who.zh: 参加过 cmETH 往期活动、还有奖励没领的人。
who.en: Anyone who joined past cmETH campaigns and still has rewards waiting.

todo.zh: 11 月 7 日前到 mETH Protocol 官网把奖励领完。cmETH 不急,随时可以解押成 mETH 或跨链。
todo.en: Collect your rewards on the mETH Protocol site before Nov 7. Your cmETH can wait: you can unstake it to mETH or bridge it at any time.

caution.zh: 官方说解押和跨链的合约「预计」在领取期过后仍可用,但会按剩下的量复查。
caution.en: mETH Protocol says the unstaking and bridging contracts are "expected" to keep working after the reward window, but it will review this based on how much is left.

name.zh: GMO Trust：GYEN、ZUSD 稳定币清盘
name.en: GMO Trust: GYEN and ZUSD stablecoins winding down

summary.zh: GYEN、ZUSD 稳定币清盘:11 月 11 日前可按面值赎回;没赎回的,年底前按 11 月 12 日的汇率换成 USDC 发回。
summary.en: GYEN and ZUSD are winding down. Redeem at face value by Nov 11, or receive USDC at the Nov 12 rate by the end of the year.

deadlineNote.zh: 按面值赎回截止到 11 月 11 日 23:59:59(美东时间),币要在截止前到账。没赎回的,官方年底前按 11 月 12 日定的汇率,在同一条链上发等值的 USDC。
deadlineNote.en: Redemption at face value closes on Nov 11 at 23:59:59 US Eastern time, and your tokens must arrive before then. For anything not redeemed, GMO Trust will send the equivalent in USDC on the same chain by the end of the year, at the rate set on Nov 12.

who.zh: 持有 GYEN 或 ZUSD 的人(以太坊、Arbitrum、Stellar 等链上)。
who.en: Anyone holding GYEN or ZUSD (on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Stellar and other chains).

todo.zh: 要按面值赎回:在 `stablecoin.z.com` 开户、完成身份认证(KYC),绑定日元(GYEN)或美元(ZUSD)的银行账户,币要在截止前到账。不赎回的:等年底强制换成 USDC。以太坊、Arbitrum 上也有 Uniswap 池子可以卖。
todo.en: To redeem at face value, open an account at `stablecoin.z.com`, pass the identity checks (KYC) and link a bank account in yen (GYEN) or US dollars (ZUSD). Your tokens must arrive before the deadline. If you don't redeem, they are converted to USDC at the end of the year. On Ethereum and Arbitrum there are also Uniswap pools where you can sell.

caution.zh: 这几种拿不到强制换的 USDC:跨到官方不支持的链上的、没通过反洗钱筛查的、低于那条链最小转账额的。Stellar 上要先开 USDC trustline。Arbitrum 上的 GYEN:官方没写过了 11 月 11 日会不会自动换成 USDC。
caution.en: You won't get the automatic USDC if your tokens were bridged to a chain GMO Trust doesn't support, didn't pass anti-money-laundering screening, or are below that chain's minimum transfer amount. On Stellar, open a USDC trustline first. For GYEN on Arbitrum, GMO Trust hasn't said whether it will be converted to USDC automatically after Nov 11.

name.zh: Blur：blur.io 网站下线,Blend 停止新借款
name.en: Blur: blur.io going offline, Blend stops new loans

summary.zh: Blur 的网站 11 月 12 日下线,Blend 同一天停止新借款:借款人要在这之前还款。
summary.en: Blur's website goes offline on Nov 12, and Blend stops new loans the same day. Borrowers need to repay before then.

deadlineNote.zh: 11 月 12 日 blur.io 网站停用;Blend 同一天停止撮合新借款,借款人要在这天之前还款,否则按协议违约。市场合约照常在链上运行。
deadlineNote.en: On Nov 12 the blur.io website stops working. Blend stops matching new loans the same day: borrowers must repay before then, or the loan defaults under the protocol's rules. The marketplace contracts keep running on-chain.

who.zh: Blend 的借款人;以及在 Blur 上还有资产、要靠 blur.io 网站操作的人。
who.en: Blend borrowers, and anyone with assets on Blur who relies on the blur.io website.

todo.zh: Blend 借款人:11 月 12 日前还款。其他人:等官方 11 月 12 日以后发布的 Blend 取回工具,只用 @blur_io 发的链接。
todo.en: Blend borrowers: repay before Nov 12. Everyone else: wait for the Blend withdrawal tool Blur says it will release after Nov 12, and only use links posted by @blur_io.

caution.zh: 官方说只认 @blur_io。Blur Pool(出价池)里的 ETH 怎么取,官方帖子没有单独说;取回工具哪天上线也还没公布。
caution.en: Blur says to trust only @blur_io. Its posts don't say separately how to withdraw ETH from Blur Pool (the bidding pool), and there's no release date yet for the withdrawal tool.

name.zh: Universal：uAssets 包装资产关停
name.en: Universal: uAssets wrapped assets shutting down

summary.zh: Universal 的 uAssets 11 月 17 日关停:之前在 Universal app 卖掉或赎回原币,之后只能走合约赎回。
summary.en: Universal's uAssets shut down on Nov 17. Sell or redeem them in the Universal app before then; after that, only a redemption contract remains.

deadlineNote.zh: 11 月 17 日协议关停。之后剩下的 uAssets 走合约赎回:Base 上的 uSOL、uXRP、uDOGE、uADA、uBTC、uLTC 分别换成 Base 上的 SOL、cbXRP、cbDOGE、cbADA、cbBTC、cbLTC,其余换成 USDC(官方说可能还会变)。
deadlineNote.en: The protocol shuts down on Nov 17. After that, remaining uAssets are redeemed through a contract: on Base, uSOL, uXRP, uDOGE, uADA, uBTC and uLTC become SOL on Base, cbXRP, cbDOGE, cbADA, cbBTC and cbLTC, and everything else becomes USDC (Universal says this may still change).

who.zh: 持有 uAssets(uSOL、uBTC、uXRP 等)的人。
who.en: Anyone holding uAssets (uSOL, uBTC, uXRP and others).

todo.zh: 11 月 17 日前在 Universal app 里卖掉,或在 mint and redeem 界面赎回原币。金额大的,照官方关停页上的邮箱联系官方。
todo.en: Before Nov 17, sell them in the Universal app or redeem them for the original asset on the mint and redeem page. For large amounts, email Universal at the address on its wind-down page.

caution.zh: 官方说会在 11 月 17 日前公布赎回合约和步骤,赎回的人多时可能变慢。放在第三方池子、借贷里的 uAssets 怎么办,官方没说。
caution.en: Universal says it will publish the redemption contract and steps before Nov 17, and redemptions may slow down when demand is high. It hasn't said what happens to uAssets held in third-party pools or lending markets.

summary.en: CAKE on opBNB needs to be bridged back to BNB Chain before Nov 23, because LayerZero is ending support for opBNB.

who.en: Anyone holding CAKE on opBNB.

todo.en: Go to PancakeSwap's bridge page, choose opBNB → BNB Chain and bridge your CAKE out. PancakeSwap's post has the steps.

caution.zh: 原因是 LayerZero 停止支持 opBNB,所以 opBNB 上别的走 LayerZero 的代币也可能受影响,看各自项目的公告。
caution.en: The cause is LayerZero ending support for opBNB, so other tokens on opBNB that use LayerZero may be affected too. Check each project's own announcements.

name.zh: Sophon 链关停
name.en: Sophon chain shutting down

summary.zh: Sophon 链 11 月 30 日关停,11 月 25 日是把钱提回以太坊的最后一天。
summary.en: The Sophon chain shuts down on Nov 30. Nov 25 is the last day to withdraw your funds to Ethereum.

deadlineNote.zh: 11 月 25 日是提款截止日,之后基础设施和相关网站开始关闭;11 月 30 日主网最终关停。
deadlineNote.en: Nov 25 is the last day to withdraw. After that the infrastructure and related websites start shutting down, and mainnet shuts down for good on Nov 30.

who.zh: 在 Sophon 链上还有 SOPH、ETH、USDC 等资产的人,农场里还有资产的人,以及质押、Guardian 奖励没领的人。
who.en: Anyone with SOPH, ETH, USDC or other assets on Sophon, anyone with assets in Sophon's farm, and anyone with uncollected staking or Guardian rewards.

todo.zh: 11 月 25 日前在官方页面把资产提回以太坊(官方帖子给的是 `claim.sophon.com`);农场里的资产到 `farm.sophon.xyz` 取;没领的质押和 Guardian 奖励领掉。节点奖励照常发到以太坊钱包。
todo.en: Before Nov 25, withdraw your assets to Ethereum on the official page (Sophon's posts give `claim.sophon.com`). Take farm assets out at `farm.sophon.xyz`, and collect any staking and Guardian rewards. Node rewards keep going to your Ethereum wallet.

caution.zh: 官方帖子里出现过两个域名:`claim.sophon.com`(10 月 19 日、11 月 2 日)和 `claim.sophon.xyz`(10 月 22 日)。官方提醒小心假迁移站。
caution.en: Sophon's posts have used two domains: `claim.sophon.com` (Oct 19 and Nov 2) and `claim.sophon.xyz` (Oct 22). Sophon warns about fake migration sites.

name.zh: Balancer 有序关停:池子转为只能取
name.en: Balancer winding down: pools moving to withdraw-only

summary.zh: Balancer 有序关停:池子已经只能取,剩下的 v3 池 11 月 30 日也转为只能取;官方说取款一直开着,流动性和质押要自己撤出来。
summary.en: Balancer is winding down. Pools are withdraw-only, and the remaining v3 pools follow on Nov 30. Balancer says withdrawals stay open, but liquidity providers and stakers need to withdraw themselves.

note.zh: 剩下的 v3 池也转为只能取(v3 Vault 暂停),取款照常
note.en: The remaining v3 pools move to withdrawals only (the v3 Vault is paused); withdrawals stay open

deadlineNote.zh: 10 月 30 日起,能暂停的池子转为只能取,漏洞赏金结束;合作方申请保留的 v3 池开到 11 月 30 日,当天 v3 Vault 暂停、剩下的 v3 池也转为只能取。官方说取款一直开着,没有截止日。之后保留简化的取款界面,一直到 veBAL 锁仓到期、两轮国库分配结束(第一轮在 2027 年 5 月底)。不能暂停的池子照常运行,协议费设为 0。
deadlineNote.en: Since Oct 30, pools that can be paused are withdraw-only and the bug bounty has ended. The v3 pools that partners asked to keep stay open until Nov 30, when the v3 Vault is paused and the remaining v3 pools move to withdrawals only. Balancer says withdrawals stay open, with no end date. After that a simplified withdrawal page stays up until veBAL locks expire and two rounds of treasury distribution are done (the first at the end of May 2027). Pools that can't be paused keep running, with protocol fees set to 0.

who.zh: 在 Balancer 池子里提供流动性的人、在 gauge 里质押的人,以及有 v3 buffer 份额或 v2 老挖矿奖励的人。官方 10 月 23 日的提醒帖说,已经找到外部用户 50 万美元以上的旧仓位。
who.en: Liquidity providers in Balancer pools, anyone staked in gauges, and anyone with v3 buffer shares or old v2 mining rewards. Balancer's Oct 23 reminder says it has found over $500,000 in old positions belonging to outside users.

todo.zh: 到 `legacy.balancer.fi` 撤出流动性、解除 gauge 质押;另外查一下 v3 buffer 份额和 v2 老挖矿奖励,这两样在 DeBank 这类资产查看工具里看不到。
todo.en: Go to `legacy.balancer.fi` to remove liquidity and unstake from gauges. Also check for v3 buffer shares and old v2 mining rewards, which portfolio trackers such as DeBank don't show.

caution.zh: 官方说合约不托管,取款不靠团队。
caution.en: Balancer says the contracts are non-custodial, so withdrawals don't depend on the team.

name.zh: Recall:质押 app 11 月 30 日起只读
name.en: Recall: staking app goes read-only on Nov 30

summary.zh: Recall 基金会关停,质押 app 11 月 30 日起只读:在这之前自己发起解押并提取。
summary.en: The Recall Foundation is winding down and its staking app goes read-only on Nov 30. Unstake and withdraw before then.

deadlineNote.zh: 10 月 30 日起,新发起的解押没有冷却期(已经在冷却的照原日期,锁仓不缩短);11 月 30 日 `app.recall.network` 变为只读。之后锁仓到期的,仍可以在 BaseScan 上直接调合约取出。
deadlineNote.en: Since Oct 30, new unstake requests have no cooldown (requests already cooling down keep their original dates, and locks aren't shortened). On Nov 30, `app.recall.network` becomes read-only. After that, positions whose lock has ended can still be withdrawn by calling the contract directly on BaseScan.

who.zh: 在 Base 上质押了 RECALL 的人。
who.en: Anyone who staked RECALL on Base.

todo.zh: 11 月 30 日前在 `app.recall.network` 自己发起解押并提取。之后:在 BaseScan 上对质押合约用 Write as Proxy 调 `unstake(tokenId)`、`withdraw(tokenId)`,要备一点 Base 上的 ETH 付手续费。
todo.en: Before Nov 30, unstake and withdraw yourself at `app.recall.network`. After that, on BaseScan, use Write as Proxy on the staking contract to call `unstake(tokenId)` and `withdraw(tokenId)`. You'll need a little ETH on Base for fees.

caution.zh: 官方说持有人没有分配,也没有新币、空投或迁移,自称提供这些的都是假的。官方长文没写质押合约地址,直接调合约前只用官方渠道给的地址。同一篇长文一处写「30 天后停止访问」,一处写「11 月 30 日只读」。
caution.en: Recall says holders get no distribution and there is no new token, airdrop or migration; anyone offering one is fake. Its announcement doesn't give the staking contract address, so before calling a contract directly, only use an address from official channels. The same post says access stops "after 30 days" in one place and "read-only on Nov 30" in another.

name.en: Megapot: app shutting down

summary.zh: Megapot 的网站和 Telegram 小程序 12 月 1 日下线:用邮箱、X、Telegram 登录的账户要在这之前把余额提走。
summary.en: Megapot's website and Telegram mini app go offline on Dec 1. If your account uses email, X or Telegram login, withdraw your balance before then.

deadlineNote.zh: 10 月 29 日起停止售票,提现不用再做身份验证;12 月 1 日 `megapot.io` 和 Telegram 小程序下线。协议本身继续运行。
deadlineNote.en: Since Oct 29, ticket sales have stopped and withdrawals no longer need identity checks. On Dec 1, `megapot.io` and the Telegram mini app go offline. The protocol itself keeps running.

who.zh: 用邮箱、X 或 Telegram 登录建了账户的人,以及有链下保底奖没领的人。自己连钱包玩的,票和奖一直在自己手里。
who.en: Anyone whose account was created with email, X or Telegram login, and anyone with an off-chain consolation prize waiting. If you played with your own wallet, your tickets and prizes stay with you.

todo.zh: 12 月 1 日前把账户余额提走,链下的保底奖也在这之前领。链上的奖和推荐费 12 月 1 日后仍可以经 Basescan 或第三方 app 领。提供流动性的随时可以取。
todo.en: Withdraw your account balance before Dec 1, and collect any off-chain consolation prize before then too. On-chain prizes and referral fees can still be collected after Dec 1 through Basescan or third-party apps. Liquidity providers can withdraw at any time.

name.en: ThunderCore chain stopped: TT moving to BNB Chain

summary.zh: ThunderCore 已经停链,TT 迁到 BNB Chain:迁移站开到 12 月 1 日。
summary.en: ThunderCore has stopped and TT is moving to BNB Chain. The migration site is open until Dec 1.

deadlineNote.zh: 8 月 28 日 ThunderBridge 停用;9 月 1 日出最后一个区块 236120709;迁移站从 9 月 1 日开到 12 月 1 日。
deadlineNote.en: ThunderBridge stopped on Aug 28. The last block, 236120709, was produced on Sep 1. The migration site is open from Sep 1 to Dec 1.

who.zh: 持有主网 TT、veTT、以太坊上的 ERC20-TT,或在 ThunderBridge 里有资产的人。放在交易所里的,听交易所安排。
who.en: Anyone holding mainnet TT, veTT, ERC20-TT on Ethereum, or assets in ThunderBridge. If yours are on an exchange, follow the exchange's instructions.

todo.zh: 到 `migration.thundercore.com` 查状态,按步骤迁移。
todo.en: Check your status at `migration.thundercore.com` and follow the migration steps.

caution.zh: 第三方代币和 NFT 不迁。9 月 1 日前还放在合约里的不会自动迁,要人工逐个审核,不保证。12 月 1 日以后怎么办,官方没说。
caution.en: Third-party tokens and NFTs are not migrated. Anything still inside a contract before Sep 1 isn't migrated automatically; it's reviewed case by case, with no guarantee. ThunderCore hasn't said what happens after Dec 1.

name.en: QuickSwap: old QUICK to new QUICK, rate drops monthly

who.zh: 还持有旧版 QUICK 的人。

From Dec 9, sign at `hub.zetachain.com/migrate` to receive ZETA on Solana (at least 10 ZETA, no SOL needed). For ZRC-20 tokens, sign at `hub.zetachain.com/bridged-assets` to get them back on their original chain.

caution.en: Proposal 70 only takes effect if it passes on Nov 7. ZRC-20 tokens worth under $5 each, or held in pools, vaults or contract wallets, can't be collected. ZetaChain says the portal only asks for a signature, never a transaction or your seed phrase.

name.zh: Kelp:关停网络上的旧版 rsETH,人工处理到 2027 年 6 月
name.en: Kelp: old rsETH on retired networks, manual process until June 2027

summary.zh: Kelp 关停网络上的旧版 rsETH 不能直接用了,可以照官方指南申请在以太坊上换回,截止 2027 年 6 月 15 日。
summary.en: Old rsETH on networks Kelp has retired no longer works directly, but you can apply through Kelp's official guide to get it back on Ethereum until Jun 15, 2027.

deadlineNote.zh: 6 月 15 日先下线了 22 条网络上的旧 rsETH;10 月 5 日起 Base、Mantle、Ink 上的旧 rsETH 也退役(换成 Chainlink CCIP 版)。人工处理截止到 2027 年 6 月 15 日 23:59(UTC)。
deadlineNote.en: Old rsETH was retired on 22 networks on Jun 15. From Oct 5, old rsETH on Base, Mantle and Ink was retired too (replaced by a Chainlink CCIP version). The manual process closes on Jun 15, 2027, 23:59 UTC.

who.zh: 在 Kelp 已关停的网络上还持有旧版 rsETH 的人。Arbitrum 不受影响。
who.en: Anyone still holding old rsETH on networks Kelp has retired. Arbitrum is not affected.

todo.zh: 只照 Kelp 官方博客的指南做:先核对手里的是旧版 rsETH 合约,再按指南的步骤提交(指南要求在原链把币发到黑洞地址、付 100 USDC 手续费、发邮件附上交易)。Kelp 按季度在以太坊上发回。
todo.en: Follow only the guide on Kelp's official blog. First confirm you hold the old rsETH contract, then submit as the guide describes (it asks you to send the tokens to a burn address on the original chain, pay a 100 USDC fee and email the transactions). Kelp sends rsETH back on Ethereum each quarter.

caution.zh: 这套流程(往黑洞地址发币、付手续费、发邮件)和常见骗局很像:只照 Kelp 官方博客的原文做,别信私信,别信别的网站。在 Base、Mantle、Ink、Linea、Optimism、Zircuit 上拆 wrsETH 得到的是新版,不用走这个流程。
caution.en: This process (sending tokens to a burn address, paying a fee, sending an email) looks a lot like common scams. Follow only the original text on Kelp's official blog, and ignore DMs and other websites. Unwrapping wrsETH on Base, Mantle, Ink, Linea, Optimism or Zircuit gives you the new version, which doesn't need this process.

label.en: Kelp blog: guide for rsETH on sunset networks

name.zh: Blast L2 已关停,官方取款站开到 2027 年 11 月
name.en: Blast L2 has shut down; official withdrawal site open until November 2027

summary.zh: Blast L2 已关停:到 blast.io 连钱包查地址,在以太坊上取回 ETH、WETH、USDB,开到 2027 年 11 月 4 日。
summary.en: Blast L2 has shut down. Connect your wallet at blast.io to look up your address and withdraw ETH, WETH and USDB on Ethereum, until Nov 4, 2027.

deadlineNote.zh: 10 月 26 日普通界面提款截止(已过);11 月 4 日官方宣布 L2 已关停。取款站 `blast.io` 开 12 个月,最后支持日是 2027 年 11 月 4 日。
deadlineNote.en: The regular withdrawal interface closed on Oct 26 (passed). On Nov 4, Blast announced the L2 has shut down. The withdrawal site at `blast.io` stays open for 12 months, with Nov 4, 2027 as the last supported day.

who.zh: 在 Blast 上还有 ETH、WETH、USDB,或有没走完的提款的人,包括用 Blast Mobile 和 Safe 等合约钱包的人。
who.en: Anyone with ETH, WETH or USDB on Blast, or a withdrawal that never finished, including Blast Mobile users and Safe or other contract-wallet users.

todo.zh: 到 `blast.io` 连接钱包查地址,在以太坊上取回 ETH、WETH、USDB;没走完的提款会自动算进去。Blast Mobile 用户:把助记词导进 MetaMask 或 Rabby 再连接。Safe 等合约钱包另有入口。
todo.en: Connect your wallet at `blast.io` to look up your address and withdraw ETH, WETH and USDB on Ethereum; unfinished withdrawals are included automatically. Blast Mobile users: import your seed phrase into MetaMask or Rabby, then connect. Safe and other contract wallets have a separate entry point.

caution.zh: 官方只认 @blast(@Blast_L2 现在是占位号)。取款站只写了 ETH 和美元类资产;L2 上的 BLAST 代币、其他代币和 DeFi 仓位能不能取,官方没写。助记词只在钱包 App 里自己导入,绝不填进任何网页。
caution.en: Blast only uses @blast (@Blast_L2 is now a placeholder account). The withdrawal site only mentions ETH and USD assets; Blast hasn't said whether the BLAST token, other tokens or DeFi positions on the L2 can be withdrawn. Only ever enter a seed phrase inside a wallet app yourself, never on a website.

name.zh: Compound III：Scroll 上的 USDC 市场清场
name.en: Compound III: closing out the USDC market on Scroll

summary.zh: Compound 要清掉 Scroll 上已停用的 USDC 市场:通过后剩下的借款会被清算,借款人尽快还款、取回抵押。
summary.en: Compound plans to close out the retired USDC market on Scroll. Once that passes, remaining loans can be liquidated, so borrowers should repay and take back their collateral soon.

deadlineNote.zh: 这个市场今年早些时候已经停用。11 月 4 日的论坛提案说:链上提案还没提交,没定日期;通过后,剩下的借款都会变成可以被清算。
deadlineNote.en: This market was retired earlier this year. A forum proposal on Nov 4 says the on-chain proposal hasn't been submitted and there's no date yet. Once it passes, all remaining loans can be liquidated.

who.zh: 在 Compound III Scroll USDC 市场里借了款或存了 USDC 的人。提案里统计有 1,959 个借款账户,都是小额。
who.en: Anyone who borrowed from or supplied USDC to the Compound III USDC market on Scroll. The proposal counts 1,959 borrower accounts, all small.

todo.zh: 借款人尽快还清 USDC,取回 WETH、wstETH 抵押;存了 USDC 的取出来。
todo.en: Borrowers: repay your USDC soon and take back your WETH or wstETH collateral. Suppliers: withdraw your USDC.

caution.zh: 提案里写,Scroll 已经宣布离开公共 L2,并建议用户关闭所有 DeFi 仓位(见本页 Scroll 那一条)。
caution.en: The proposal notes that Scroll has announced it is leaving the public L2 model and advises users to close all DeFi positions (see the Scroll entry on this page).

name.en: Parasail: stPEAQ staking pool retired, moving to withdraw-only

summary.en: Parasail's stPEAQ staking pool was retired after an exploit. Parasail says the peaq foundation is covering the loss so every user can withdraw in full. Wait for the official withdrawal date.

deadlineNote.zh: 只能取模式哪天开,官方还没定。
deadlineNote.en: Parasail hasn't set a date yet for withdraw-only mode to open.

who.zh: 持有 stPEAQ 的人。
who.en: Anyone holding stPEAQ.

todo.zh: 等官方公布只能取模式的时间和取款链接,再取回 PEAQ。
todo.en: Wait for Parasail to announce when withdraw-only mode opens and the withdrawal link, then withdraw your PEAQ.

caution.zh: 这个池子被盗过:官方说被盗 1,096,424.06 PEAQ。只信官方渠道发的链接。
caution.en: This pool was exploited: Parasail says 1,096,424.06 PEAQ was stolen. Only trust links from official channels.

name.zh: Scroll 转为许可制网络,SCR 迁到以太坊主网(提案)
name.en: Scroll moving to a permissioned network, SCR to Ethereum mainnet (proposal)

summary.zh: Scroll 提议转为许可制网络:DeFi 仓位要在转型前自己平掉或处理,先到官方页面查持仓。
summary.en: Scroll has proposed becoming a permissioned network. DeFi positions need to be closed or handled before the switch, so check your holdings on the official page first.

deadlineNote.zh: 11 月 3 日论坛提案上线,还要 DAO 投票。官方说网络升级在「年底」,具体日期没定。
deadlineNote.en: The forum proposal went up on Nov 3 and still needs a DAO vote. Scroll says the network upgrade is planned for "the end of the year", with no exact date yet.

who.zh: 在 Scroll 上有资产,特别是有借贷、流动性等 DeFi 仓位的人,以及持有 SCR 的人。
who.en: Anyone with assets on Scroll, especially DeFi positions such as lending or liquidity, and SCR holders.

todo.zh: 到 `positions.scroll.io` 查持仓;DeFi 仓位在转型前自己平掉或处理。官方桥照常开,官方说升级后也支持。
todo.en: Check your holdings at `positions.scroll.io`, and close or handle DeFi positions before the switch. The official bridge stays open, and Scroll says it will still work after the upgrade.

caution.zh: 提案还没投票。官方说 SCR 总量和代币经济不变。Aave、Compound 已经在撤 Scroll 上的市场。
caution.en: The proposal hasn't been voted on yet. Scroll says SCR's total supply and tokenomics won't change. Aave and Compound are already winding down their Scroll markets.

name.zh: Compound III:以太坊、Linea、Ronin、Mantle、Unichain、Polygon 上一批市场停用
name.en: Compound III: markets retired on Ethereum, Linea, Ronin, Mantle, Unichain and Polygon

summary.zh: Compound III 停用了一批市场:不能新借,存款收益归零;还有存款的取出来,借款人还款取回抵押。
summary.en: Compound III has retired a batch of markets: no new borrowing and no more yield on deposits. Withdraw any deposits, and borrowers should repay to take back their collateral.

deadlineNote.zh: 没有硬截止。9 月 2 日提议停用以太坊 wstETH 市场;9 月 25 日五条链上停用市场的借款抵押因子归零;10 月 30 日提议停用以太坊 WBTC 市场。Linea USDC 市场 9 月 18 日起暂停取款,Mantle USDe 市场 10 月 16 日起暂停取款。
deadlineNote.en: There's no hard deadline. On Sep 2, retiring the Ethereum wstETH market was proposed; on Sep 25, borrowing collateral factors on retired markets on five chains were set to zero; on Oct 30, retiring the Ethereum WBTC market was proposed. Withdrawals from the Linea USDC market have been paused since Sep 18, and from the Mantle USDe market since Oct 16.

who.zh: 在这些停用市场里还有存款或借款的人。提案里统计,以太坊 wstETH 市场还有 93 个存款人,WBTC 市场还有 37 个。
who.en: Anyone with deposits or loans in these retired markets. The proposals count 93 suppliers left in the Ethereum wstETH market and 37 in the WBTC market.

todo.zh: 停用市场里还有存款的取出来;借款人还款取回抵押。Linea USDC、Mantle USDe 两个市场取款暂停中,恢复后再取。
todo.en: Withdraw any deposits left in retired markets; borrowers should repay and take back their collateral. Withdrawals from the Linea USDC and Mantle USDe markets are paused for now, so withdraw once they resume.

caution.zh: Linea 那次暂停是「发现潜在问题」,修好后恢复;Mantle 那次是为了执行提走储备金的提案。
caution.en: The Linea pause is due to a "potential issue" and lifts once it's fixed; the Mantle pause is for carrying out a proposal to withdraw reserves.

name.zh: Aerodrome、Velodrome 合并为 Aero
name.en: Aerodrome and Velodrome merging into Aero

summary.zh: Aerodrome 和 Velodrome 合并为 Aero:老池子已停发奖励,流动性要自己撤到新池子;代币和锁仓在官方升级入口自己升级。
summary.en: Aerodrome and Velodrome have merged into Aero. Old pools no longer pay rewards, so move your liquidity to new pools, and upgrade tokens and locks yourself on the official upgrade page.

deadlineNote.zh: 10 月 15 日前要把 OP Mainnet 和 Ink 以外的 xVELO 跨回 OP;10 月 20 日前要把 veNFT 从 Relay 等金库撤出;10 月 22 日 00:00(UTC)老池子奖励停发、升级入口开放。官方说升级没有截止日。
deadlineNote.en: xVELO outside OP Mainnet and Ink had to be bridged back to OP by Oct 15, and veNFTs had to be removed from Relay and other vaults by Oct 20. On Oct 22, 00:00 UTC, rewards on old pools stopped and the upgrade page opened. Aero says there's no deadline to upgrade.

who.zh: 持有 AERO、VELO、veAERO、veVELO 的人,以及在老池子里提供流动性的人。
who.en: Holders of AERO, VELO, veAERO or veVELO, and liquidity providers in old pools.

todo.zh: 在 `aerodrome.finance` 或 `velodrome.finance` 的升级入口自己升级:AERO 按 1:1、VELO 按 1:0.044 换新 AERO,veAERO、veVELO 转成 sAERO。升级前先领完奖励和 rebase、清掉投票。老池子没有奖励了,流动性要自己撤到新池子。
todo.en: Upgrade on the upgrade page at `aerodrome.finance` or `velodrome.finance`: AERO converts 1:1 and VELO at 1:0.044 into new AERO, and veAERO or veVELO become sAERO. Before upgrading, collect your rewards and rebases and clear your votes. Old pools pay no rewards, so move your liquidity to new pools.

caution.zh: 升级不可逆;升级前没领的奖励,之后领不回来。官方说老前端「以后可能关」。
caution.en: Upgrading can't be undone, and rewards you haven't collected before upgrading are lost. Aero says the old front-ends "may close later".

summary.zh: Venus 在逐步停用 VAI、下架 lisUSD 和 TRX 市场:VAI 金库里的钱随时可取,借款人准备还款。
summary.en: Venus is phasing out VAI and delisting the lisUSD and TRX markets. VAI in the vault can be withdrawn at any time; borrowers should get ready to repay.

deadlineNote.zh: 起因是 Chainlink 要停掉 VAI 的价格源。没有硬截止:VIP-662 于 9 月 21 日执行(VAI 金库停发 XVS 奖励);VIP-663 于 9 月 28 日执行(TRX、lisUSD 进入下一阶段)。后续步骤官方说另行公布。
deadlineNote.en: This started because Chainlink is retiring the VAI price feed. There's no hard deadline: VIP-662 took effect on Sep 21 (the VAI vault stopped paying XVS rewards), and VIP-663 on Sep 28 (TRX and lisUSD moved to the next phase). Venus says later steps will be announced separately.

who.zh: 在 VAI 金库里存了 VAI、铸了 VAI,或在 lisUSD、TRX 市场有存款或借款的人。
who.en: Anyone with VAI in the VAI vault, anyone who minted VAI, and anyone with deposits or loans in the lisUSD or TRX markets.

todo.zh: VAI 金库里的 VAI 随时可取,已经累计的 XVS 还能领;铸了 VAI 的准备还款;lisUSD 存款取出来,借款在第三阶段加息前还掉。
todo.en: VAI in the vault can be withdrawn at any time, and XVS already earned can still be collected. If you minted VAI, get ready to repay. Withdraw lisUSD deposits, and repay lisUSD loans before interest rises in phase three.

name.zh: Aave V3:六个部署整体停用,一批低使用资产下架
name.en: Aave V3: six deployments retired, low-use assets delisted

summary.zh: Aave V3 停用 Sonic、Scroll、zkSync Era、Metis、Soneium、Aptos 六个部署:存款尽快取出,借款人还款取回抵押,免得降清算阈值时被清算。
summary.en: Aave V3 is retiring six deployments: Sonic, Scroll, zkSync Era, Metis, Soneium and Aptos. Withdraw deposits soon, and borrowers should repay before liquidation thresholds drop.

deadlineNote.zh: 没有硬截止:市场已冻结,储备因子 99%(利息几乎都归金库)。官方说之后可能再加息、逐步降低清算阈值。
deadlineNote.en: There's no hard deadline. The markets are frozen with a 99% reserve factor, so almost all interest goes to the treasury. Aave says it may raise rates further and gradually lower liquidation thresholds.

who.zh: 在这六个部署上有存款或借款的人,以及在其他部署上持有被下架资产的人。
who.en: Anyone with deposits or loans on these six deployments, and anyone holding the delisted assets on other deployments.

todo.zh: 这六个部署上的存款尽快取出;借款人还款取回抵押,免得降清算阈值时被清算。
todo.en: Withdraw deposits from these six deployments soon. Borrowers: repay and take back your collateral so you aren't liquidated when thresholds drop.

name.en: Marinus: Harmony markets retired, withdraw-only

who.zh: 在 Harmony 上往 Marinus 存过钱或质押的人。
who.en: Anyone who deposited into or staked with Marinus on Harmony.

name.zh: Harmony 主网关停,ONE 迁到以太坊
name.en: Harmony mainnet shutting down, ONE moving to Ethereum

summary.zh: Harmony 主网关停,ONE 按 9 月 10 日快照空投到以太坊上的同一地址;老钱包要签名确认,区块浏览器 11 月 18 日关。
summary.en: Harmony mainnet is shutting down and ONE was airdropped to the same address on Ethereum based on the Sep 10 snapshot. Older wallets need to sign to confirm, and the block explorer closes on Nov 18.

note.zh: 区块浏览器 explorer.harmony.one 关闭
note.en: The block explorer at explorer.harmony.one closes

deadlineNote.zh: 9 月 10 日 14:00(UTC)快照(已过);10 月 2 日起往以太坊上的同一地址空投 ERC-20 ONE;11 月 18 日关闭 `explorer.harmony.one`(这是区块浏览器的数据,不是换币截止)。
deadlineNote.en: The snapshot was taken on Sep 10 at 14:00 UTC (passed). Since Oct 2, ERC-20 ONE has been airdropped to the same address on Ethereum. `explorer.harmony.one` closes on Nov 18 (that's block explorer data, not a token deadline).

who.zh: 快照时在 Harmony 上持有 ONE 的人、用老钱包的人,以及要导出 2025 年以前区块浏览器数据的人。

summary.en: Since Oct 29, Stader's BNBx can no longer be redeemed through the contract. Instead you apply by email, following Stader's official blog: 1 BNBx pays 1.1099 BNB, minus a 0.2 BNBx fee per request, settled quarterly.

deadlineNote.zh: 1 月 29 日起 BNBx 停用、只能赎回,3 月起比例固定在 1 BNBx 兑 1.1099 BNB。10 月 29 日以前可以在合约里即时、免费赎回(已过);10 月 29 日起只能发邮件申请,按季度结算。申请开到哪天,公告没写。
deadlineNote.en: BNBx was sunset on Jan 29 and has been redeem-only since; its rate has been fixed at 1.1099 BNB per BNBx since March. Instant, free redemption through the contract was possible before Oct 29 (passed). From Oct 29, redemption is by email request only, settled quarterly. The announcement doesn't say how long requests stay open.

who.zh: 还持有 BNBx 的人(BNB Chain)。放在 DEX 池子或借贷协议里的,官方说要先取回自己的钱包。
who.en: Anyone still holding BNBx on BNB Chain. If yours is in a DEX pool or a lending protocol, Stader says to withdraw it to your own wallet first.

todo.zh: 只照 Stader 官方博客(`staderlabs.com/blog`)那篇公告的步骤做:从持有 BNBx 的那个钱包发出,只用 BNB Chain,再按公告写的格式发邮件附上交易。官方只付给发币的那个钱包,别从交易所账户发。手续费固定 0.2 BNBx,持有得少,扣掉的比例就大。
todo.en: Follow only the steps in the announcement on Stader's official blog (`staderlabs.com/blog`): send from the wallet that holds the BNBx, on BNB Chain only, then email the transaction in the format the post describes. Stader only pays the wallet that sent the tokens, so don't send from an exchange account. The fee is a fixed 0.2 BNBx, so it takes a bigger share of a small balance.

caution.zh: 这套流程(把币发到一个地址、再发邮件)和常见骗局很像:地址和邮箱只认 Stader 官方博客原文里写的,本页不转抄。Stader 说它不会私信你,不会要助记词、私钥,也不会让你付钱。不要使用私信、群聊或其他网站提供的申领地址;请回到下方 Stader 官方博客原文核对。
caution.en: This process (sending tokens to an address, then emailing) looks a lot like common scams. Only trust the address and email in the original post on Stader's official blog; this page deliberately doesn't copy them. Stader says it will never DM you, ask for your seed phrase or private keys, or ask you to send a payment. Do not use claim addresses supplied in DMs, group chats or other websites; verify them in the Stader blog linked below.

deadlineNote.en: Deposits closed in June and MaticX has been redeem-only since. The MaticX app closed on Aug 3, and redemptions continue through Etherscan. From Oct 29, the rate is fixed at 1.2002 POL per MaticX. Aug 3, 2029 is the last day to redeem through the contract.

who.zh: 还持有 MaticX 的人(以太坊、Polygon PoS)。
who.en: Anyone still holding MaticX, on Ethereum or Polygon PoS.

todo.zh: 照 Stader 官方博客的步骤,在 Etherscan 上打开以太坊上的 MaticX 合约:先发起取款(MaticX 会被销毁),等 POL 解绑完成,再把 POL 提到钱包。公告称解绑需 80 个检查点,发布时估计约 22 小时。在 Polygon PoS 上的,先经 Polygon 官方桥转到以太坊。已经发起过取款的不受影响,直接提 POL。
todo.en: Follow the steps on Stader's official blog: open the MaticX contract on Ethereum in Etherscan, request a withdrawal (your MaticX is burned), wait for the POL to finish unbonding, then withdraw the POL to your wallet. The announcement gives an unbonding period of 80 checkpoints, estimated at about 22 hours at publication. MaticX on Polygon PoS has to be moved to Ethereum through the Polygon bridge first. Withdrawals you already requested are not affected; just finish them.

caution.zh: 放在借贷市场、流动性池、金库里的 MaticX 会原样留在那里,官方让你去问那个协议:比例固定以后,对你的仓位有什么影响。合约地址只认 Stader 官方博客里写的。
caution.en: MaticX in a lending market, liquidity pool or vault stays where it is; Stader says to ask that protocol how the fixed rate affects your position. Only use the contract address given in Stader's official blog post.

Moonbeam said the chain would keep running through the transition period until Jul 31, and that once the chain winds down, funds left in on-chain protocols "may become inaccessible". The announcement doesn't say when the chain stops.

caution.zh: 官方迁移页是 `migrate.portal.moonbeam.network`;这份 7 月 3 日公告未说明它在截止后是否仍可使用。私信你、说能「补迁移」的都别信。
caution.en: The official migration page is `migrate.portal.moonbeam.network`; the Jul 3 announcement does not say whether it remains usable after the deadline. Ignore anyone who DMs you offering a "late migration".

summary.zh: Summer.fi 正在关停,Lazy Summer 金库只能取,现在还可以在官网自己取。11 月 5 日有一份有序关停的社区讨论稿,统一取出后经 Merkl 发回只是选项之一。
summary.en: Summer.fi is winding down and Lazy Summer vaults are withdraw-only; you can still withdraw yourself on the official site. A Nov 5 community RFC discusses an orderly wind-down, and sweeping what's left to Merkl is only one option.

deadlineNote.zh: 7 月 6 日被盗后,Summer.fi 旧应用界面原定 8 月 31 日停用(现在的官网只留退出页),金库不再收存款、只能取。11 月 5 日的社区讨论稿(RFC)列了有序关停的几种做法:拍快照后统一取出、经 Merkl 按原币在原链发回;先公布截止日让用户自己取,过期剩下的再归集;或者不归集。还没定日期。
deadlineNote.en: After the Jul 6 exploit, the original Summer.fi app interface was scheduled to close on Aug 31 (the site now only offers an exit page), and the vaults stopped taking deposits and became withdraw-only. A Nov 5 community RFC lists options for an orderly wind-down: take a snapshot, withdraw everything and return it through Merkl in the same token on the same chain; announce a deadline for users to withdraw themselves, then sweep the rest; or don't sweep at all. No date has been set.

who.zh: 在 Lazy Summer 金库里还有存款的人(以太坊、Base、Arbitrum、Sonic、HyperEVM)。讨论稿说,11 月 5 日时 16 个金库里还剩约 36.9 万美元。
who.en: Anyone with deposits left in Lazy Summer vaults (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Sonic, HyperEVM). The RFC says about $369,000 was left in 16 vaults as of Nov 5.

todo.zh: 到 `summer.fi` 连上钱包,查看并取出仓位,没领的奖励也一并领了。统一取出后经 Merkl 申领只是备选方案之一;处理方式及取款期限须等后续正式治理决定。
todo.en: Go to `summer.fi`, connect your wallet, then view and exit your positions and collect any outstanding rewards. Sweeping assets for Merkl claims is one option; the method and any withdrawal deadline depend on later formal governance decisions.

caution.zh: 这是 11 月 5 日的社区讨论稿,附非约束性意见投票,本身不转移资金。讨论稿说 7 月 6 日被盗(以太坊上的 USDC 金库)和坏账的损失补不全。请从 `summer.fi` 核对取款入口,不要仅凭论坛帖或链上提案中的链接连接钱包或签名。
caution.en: This Nov 5 community RFC includes non-binding polls and does not itself move funds. It says losses from the Jul 6 exploit (Ethereum USDC vaults) and from bad debt won't be covered in full. Verify the exit page at `summer.fi`; do not connect or sign merely because a link appears in a forum post or on-chain proposal.
